specialty_focus: Performance Health is a full-service distributor and manufacturer of rehabilitation and wellness products, serving U.S. clinical markets and operating globally. It specializes in pain relief, performance, exercise, recovery, and sports medicine, and owns brands such as TheraBand, Biofreeze, and Cramer.
